scope: All36 original organic no-change cases, every full frozen case/raw source object and occurrence context, complete candidate owner scope, all exact proposed owner deltas. No sampling and no self-review of vitamin science.

case_assessments.assessment: TOGO M2313 names brown-algal laminarin as one alternative carbon source, without species. Existing CHEBI:6364/CAS9008-22-4 is generic polymer identity. Preferred-label repair preserves its former Laminaria digitata procurement detail as a catalog variant and supplied form; it does not prove that species for TOGO.

Full TOGO M2844 comments establish the combined 0.5% bromothymol blue in 0.2 N KOH stock and 5 mL dose. The fragmented 0.2NKOH label does not identify this entire stock globally. Percentage basis/carrier remain unknown; no water or mass conversion is fabricated.

Direct JCM600 lines32–33 describe an anaerobic autoclaved stock, 5.0 mM toluene (water-saturated), added as 40 mL/L. Payload transcribes that descriptor and water presence without inferring saturation temperature, water grade, final-medium concentration or nitrogen as material.

Both frozen DSM672 occurrences preserve an explicit OR between Difco0003 and0001. A single actual product choice is not established; the hold is an alternative-material ambiguity, not a missing receiving mass or permission to model.

ATCC474 independently names BD211260 fluid thioglycollate at29.5g/L with separate yeast extract/sodium thioglycollate. TOGO M148/JCM157 names BBL fluid medium. The product owner is bounded to commercial medium; the ATCC177 scratch alternative is not copied as certified dry-product composition.

All three FEBA source records are liquid one-fold R2A outgrowth media. Actual MICRO0000541 definition is liquid with six named qualitative constituents; its separate agar-bearing historical annotation is not used as broth composition. Worker03 DAIGO owner denotes a branded dehydrated powder with eight dry inputs. No FEBA supplier/product equivalence is established.

Actual TOGO M2972 component label explicitly names Difco R2A agar; its plant-stem surface-contact comment agrees with agar interpretation. Existing MICRO0000543 owner receives provenance/type correction only; bare R2A(Difco) does not become a global alias.
NBRC19 specifically names USB Peptic Pepton at2g/L in the full rust-fungi formula. Opaque product identity is supportable without inventing substrate, exact catalog or equivalence to another peptone.

DSMZ88 names sulfide ore at20g/L for DSM5348 and uses pyrite as an example. Generic material owner correctly avoids FeS2 identity, mandatory chalcopyrite/pyrite components or inferred mineral assay; powdered sulfur remains separate.

Both Song MediaDB recipes report dTMP membership with unavailable quantity, not VARIABLE. CHEBI17013 is neutral; CHEBI46960 is anionic; broader CHEBI15245 does not supply actual reagent form. No independently documented supplied form or stock preparation is available, so the hold remains scientific.

Private full Denger2010 Methods explicitly specify racemic sulfolactate synthesized by Roy2003; Roy full Methods names sodium sulfolactate from acidic diazotization with acetic acid substitution. Sodium stoichiometry, hydrate and purity remain unknown. Source-qualified salt preparation is justified, but its parent grade must be NARROW_MATCH, not BROAD_MATCH.

Current generic Trypticase Soy Broth owner and NBRC957/1045 are distinct from the added agar and added NaCl. Actual MICRO0000113 explicitly includes Trypticase soy broth and its standard BBL formula. Six-part assertion transcribes standard broth including solvent; digest identities remain literal, and product-lot adjustment is not certified.

Both M949/M950 point to JCM906, which separately autoclaves100mL of0.5M glycine–NaOH pH10 buffer. Distilled water is explicit for900mL base, not stock; unknown carrier and NaOH amount are correctly omitted. Stock quantities are not the imported100G_PER_L dose.

All three CCAP contexts use Ward cereal leaves before boiling/filter extraction: FCGM and HEPES variant1.25g/L, NCL75S1g/L. Existing generic tissue owner can be promoted while retaining source and counts; no grain, standardized Cerophyll formula or extract-as-leaf identity is asserted.

NBRC1394 gives PQQ at1mg/L but no salt, CAS or supplier. CHEBI18315 and Sigma neutral-acid nomenclature establish a candidate identity, not actual supplied form. Absence of a salt qualifier cannot justify exact neutral-acid source assignment. The receiving-dose defect is separate.

MediaDive2119 retains6-methylnicotinate and a derived methyl-ester match; TCI M1893 CAS5470-70-2 explicitly denotes the methyl ester. Neither automatic cross-reference nor5g/L determines ester versus acid/salt; existing unmapped source owner remains appropriate.

Frozen Na-stearate raw record and full existing CHEBI132109/CAS822-16-2 owner agree on sodium stearate. Existing labels already cover the source; no additional owner or alias delta is necessary. Inherited content-bound release hold is preserved.
